place_fields.vibe: Scenic lakeside boating and quiet nature outing
place_fields.summary: Boating activity associated with the Kanva Reservoir, a man-made reservoir surrounded by wooded hills and used for recreation and birdwatching.
place_fields.best_time: Early morning or late afternoon; activity availability may vary with operator and conditions.

planning_attributes.description: Boating and related water activities are offered at Kanva Reservoir near Ramanagara.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Kanva Dam was built in 1946 across the Kanva River for irrigation; the reservoir is a major local water body and scenic attraction.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach the Kanva Reservoir area in Ramanagara district by road; activity providers operate from the reservoir/backwaters.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Activity access is subject to the operating provider and current site conditions.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow operator instructions and use the provided safety equipment for boating or other water activities.
planning_attributes.notes: Current activity listings describe boating, kayaking and other water activities at Kanva Reservoir.

place_fields.micro_region: Avati village, Devanahalli taluk, Bengaluru Rural district, Karnataka
place_fields.summary: Avathi Lake is a natural lake surrounded by greenery and rocky landscapes, suitable for a calm lakeside visit, walking and photography.
place_fields.best_time: Morning or late afternoon for a comfortable outdoor visit.

planning_attributes.description: Avathi Lake is a scenic water body near Avati village in Devanahalli taluk, with surrounding greenery, rocky terrain, birdlife and views toward Avathi Hills.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Travel toward Avati village in Devanahalli taluk in Bengaluru Rural district; the lake is near Avathi Hills and Sri Thimmaraya Swamy Temple.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: No specific formal restriction was verified; conditions at the lakeside may vary.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Carry water and sun/rain protection, use comfortable footwear, and avoid unsafe activity in or around the lake.
planning_attributes.notes: Karnataka government tourism information identifies the lake as a natural/scenic destination and notes nearby Avathi Hills.

place_fields.vibe: Adventure-focused lakeside camp and day outing
place_fields.summary: Kanva Adventure Camp is an outdoor adventure and camping venue near Kanva Reservoir offering kayaking, rope activities, ziplining and other lake-based recreation.
place_fields.best_time: Morning through afternoon for the activity program; operator schedules vary.

planning_attributes.description: The camp offers a mix of water and land adventure activities including kayaking, ziplining, rope walking, bridges and lake activities.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The venue is listed at Koonamuddanahalli, Karnataka 562108, near the Kanva Reservoir area and accessible from Ramanagara.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Activities are subject to the venue/operator schedule and participation requirements.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Use the safety equipment supplied by the operator and follow instructor guidance, particularly for kayaking, ziplining and rope activities.
planning_attributes.notes: Published activity listings describe day-out programs and a range of adventure activities at the camp.
